# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** College student  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy is adorably handsome with glorious dark eyes. He possesses a deep, black, velvety smile. His sister Dorothy resembles him, though she has roguish hazel eyes where he has dreamy dark eyes.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Roy is romantic, clever, and soft-spoken with a pleading, delightful voice. He acts with unfailing and deferential courtesy toward others. Despite his inscrutable, melancholy, and dramatic appearance, he entirely lacks a sense of humor and fails to catch the point of jokes. While sweet-tempered, he is ultimately described as uninteresting in company.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## Goals

- to woo and marry Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 c38 P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)</sub>

## History

Roy Gardner belonged to an elite Kingsport family, but was forced to interrupt his college studies for two years to travel abroad with his ailing mother. After returning to Redmond, he met Anne Shirley and began courting her in a lavishly romantic manner, frequently sending her orchids, violets, and sonnets. His attentiveness made him a frequent topic of gossip and social expectation among college social circles. Over time, his mother and sisters came to welcome Anne into their circle. Eventually, Roy proposed marriage to Anne, but she declined his proposal after realizing she did not love him.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P1](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0001), [v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)_
